component.name: Whitecube Trainer
component.summary: Train and compare small local language models

description.p: A native desktop workshop for preparing corpora, training small CPU or CUDA language models, and comparing saved checkpoints.
Monitor training metrics, resume interrupted runs, generate text previews, benchmark checkpoints, and export portable Jupyter notebooks.
The desktop uses GTK4 and libadwaita. Training runs in a Python environment you select, independently of the desktop process.
